workflows.name: Sign In — authentication succeeds
workflows.conditional_branch: Authentication == Success
workflows.on_success: Signed in successfully. Redirects to the Accounts Overview page.

workflows.name: Sign In — authentication fails
workflows.conditional_branch: Authentication == Failure
workflows.on_success: Incorrect email or password. Please try again; password field is cleared and user may retry.

workflows.name: Use Forgot Password link
workflows.on_success: Opens the password recovery / Forgot Password flow (navigates to password recovery page).

workflows.name: Complete registration and submit valid form
workflows.on_success: Account created successfully — please sign in, then redirects to the login page.

workflows.name: Click masked account number in table row
workflows.on_success: Account number is clickable in the UI, but navigation/details are not implemented yet (click is currently a no-op)

workflows.name: Open Checking — valid deposit and sufficient funds
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Deposit_Amount >= 25 AND Funding_Sufficient == true
workflows.on_success: Account opened successfully! Redirect to accounts overview.

workflows.name: Open Savings — valid deposit and sufficient funds
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Deposit_Amount >= 100 AND Funding_Sufficient == true
workflows.on_success: Account opened successfully! Redirect to accounts overview.

workflows.name: Attempt Open Checking — deposit below minimum
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Deposit_Amount < 25
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: deposit amount must be at least $25

workflows.name: Attempt Open Savings — deposit below minimum
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Deposit_Amount < 100
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: deposit amount must be at least $100

workflows.name: Attempt Open Checking — funding account insufficient (deposit meets minimum)
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Deposit_Amount >= 25 AND Funding_Sufficient == false
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: funding account has insufficient balance

workflows.name: Attempt Open Savings — funding account insufficient (deposit meets minimum)
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Deposit_Amount >= 100 AND Funding_Sufficient == false
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: funding account has insufficient balance

workflows.name: Attempt Open Checking — deposit below minimum AND funding insufficient
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Checking AND Deposit_Amount < 25 AND Funding_Sufficient == false
workflows.on_success: Validation errors shown: deposit amount must be at least $25 AND funding account has insufficient balance

workflows.name: Attempt Open Savings — deposit below minimum AND funding insufficient
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == Savings AND Deposit_Amount < 100 AND Funding_Sufficient == false
workflows.on_success: Validation errors shown: deposit amount must be at least $100 AND funding account has insufficient balance

workflows.name: Attempt Open — account type not selected
workflows.conditional_branch: Account_Type == null
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: account type is required

workflows.name: Attempt Open — deposit amount not numeric
workflows.conditional_branch: Deposit_Amount == non-numeric
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown: deposit amount must be numeric

workflows.name: Internal transfer — successful
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == My_ParaBank_Account AND Transfer_Amount_Valid == true AND Sufficient_Funds == true
workflows.on_success: Transfer completed successfully; transaction ID displayed.

workflows.name: Internal transfer — insufficient funds
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == My_ParaBank_Account AND Sufficient_Funds == false
workflows.on_success: Display error: 'Insufficient funds'.

workflows.name: Internal transfer — invalid transfer amount
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == My_ParaBank_Account AND Transfer_Amount_Valid == false
workflows.on_success: Display validation error for invalid transfer amount.

workflows.name: External transfer — successful
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == External_Account AND Transfer_Amount_Valid == true AND Sufficient_Funds == true AND AccountNumbers_Match == true
workflows.on_success: Transfer completed successfully; transaction ID displayed.

workflows.name: External transfer — account numbers do not match
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == External_Account AND AccountNumbers_Match == false
workflows.on_success: Display error: 'Account numbers do not match'.

workflows.name: External transfer — invalid transfer amount
workflows.conditional_branch: Transfer_Type == External_Account AND Transfer_Amount_Valid == false
workflows.on_success: Display validation error for invalid transfer amount.

workflows.name: Submit payment (successful submission)
workflows.on_success: Payment submitted successfully; returns a reference code and updates balances.

workflows.name: Personal loan — approved
workflows.conditional_branch: Loan_Type == Personal AND Loan_Amount >= 1000 AND Loan_Amount <= 50000 AND Down_Payment < Loan_Amount AND Down_Payment >= 0.10 * Loan_Amount AND Collateral_Account_Balance >= 0.20 * Loan_Amount AND Credit_Engine_Result == Approved
workflows.on_success: Loan approved and created successfully! (shows account details)

workflows.name: Personal loan — denied (Insufficient credit history)
workflows.conditional_branch: Loan_Type == Personal AND Loan_Amount >= 1000 AND Loan_Amount <= 50000 AND Down_Payment < Loan_Amount AND Down_Payment >= 0.10 * Loan_Amount AND Collateral_Account_Balance >= 0.20 * Loan_Amount AND Credit_Engine_Result == Denied_Insufficient_Credit
workflows.on_success: Loan denied: Insufficient credit history

workflows.name: Personal loan — denied (Inadequate collateral value)
workflows.conditional_branch: Loan_Type == Personal AND Loan_Amount >= 1000 AND Loan_Amount <= 50000 AND Down_Payment < Loan_Amount AND Down_Payment >= 0.10 * Loan_Amount AND Collateral_Account_Balance < 0.20 * Loan_Amount
workflows.on_success: Loan denied: Inadequate collateral value

workflows.name: Personal loan — denied (Down payment below minimum 10%)
workflows.conditional_branch: Loan_Type == Personal AND Loan_Amount >= 1000 AND Loan_Amount <= 50000 AND Down_Payment < 0.10 * Loan_Amount
workflows.on_success: Loan denied: Minimum down payment not met (10% required)

workflows.name: Update Profile
workflows.on_success: Profile updated successfully. Refreshes the data.

workflows.name: Request Card — successful submission
workflows.on_success: Card request submitted successfully. (tracking ID shown)

workflows.name: Update Controls — successful update (all validations pass)
workflows.conditional_branch: Spending limit within policy AND Travel notice dates valid AND Status transition allowed
workflows.on_success: Card controls updated successfully.

workflows.name: Update Controls — validation failure: spending limit exceeds policy
workflows.conditional_branch: Spending limit exceeds policy
workflows.on_success: Validation failures appear inline, and the form stays editable.

workflows.name: Update Controls — validation failure: travel notice dates invalid
workflows.conditional_branch: Travel notice dates invalid
workflows.on_success: Validation failures appear inline, and the form stays editable.

workflows.name: Update Controls — validation failure: status transition not allowed
workflows.conditional_branch: Status transition not allowed
workflows.on_success: Validation failures appear inline, and the form stays editable.

workflows.name: Buy trade executed successfully
workflows.conditional_branch: Action == Buy AND Fund_Symbol_Exists == true AND Quantity > 0 AND Buying_Power >= Required_Buying_Power
workflows.on_success: Trade executed successfully. Order ID displayed.

workflows.name: Sell trade executed successfully
workflows.conditional_branch: Action == Sell AND Fund_Symbol_Exists == true AND Quantity > 0 AND Share_Balance >= Quantity
workflows.on_success: Trade executed successfully. Order ID displayed.

workflows.name: Execute Trade with invalid fund symbol
workflows.conditional_branch: Fund_Symbol_Exists == false
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; trade not executed.

workflows.name: Execute Trade with non-positive quantity
workflows.conditional_branch: Quantity <= 0
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; trade not executed.

workflows.name: Buy trade fails due to insufficient buying power
workflows.conditional_branch: Action == Buy AND Buying_Power < Required_Buying_Power
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; trade not executed.

workflows.name: Sell trade fails due to insufficient share balance
workflows.conditional_branch: Action == Sell AND Share_Balance < Quantity
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; trade not executed.

workflows.name: Create recurring investment plan successfully
workflows.conditional_branch: Start_Date > Today AND Contribution_Amount >= Minimum AND Funding_Account_Balance >= Contribution_Amount
workflows.on_success: Plan created successfully.

workflows.name: Create Plan fails due to start date in the past
workflows.conditional_branch: Start_Date <= Today
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; 'Start date must be in the future'.

workflows.name: Create Plan fails due to contribution below minimum
workflows.conditional_branch: Contribution_Amount < Minimum
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; contribution below minimum.

workflows.name: Create Plan fails due to insufficient funding account balance
workflows.conditional_branch: Funding_Account_Balance < Contribution_Amount
workflows.on_success: Validation error shown inline; plan not created.

workflows.name: Generate statement — Month and Year period
workflows.conditional_branch: Statement_Period == Month_And_Year
workflows.on_success: Statement generated successfully.

workflows.name: Generate statement — Custom date range
workflows.conditional_branch: Statement_Period == Custom_Date_Range
workflows.on_success: Statement generated successfully.

workflows.name: Save e-statement preference — Opt into paperless (email validated)
workflows.conditional_branch: Paperless_OptIn == true
workflows.on_success: e-Statement preference updated.

workflows.name: Save e-statement preference — Opt out of paperless
workflows.conditional_branch: Paperless_OptIn == false
workflows.on_success: e-Statement preference updated.

workflows.on_success: Password changed successfully.

workflows.name: Send secure message (Send Message)
workflows.on_success: Message sent successfully. (with a ticket ID)

workflows.name: Request callback (Request Callback)
workflows.on_success: Callback request submitted. (email confirmation sent)
